past participle praṇata in genitive singular
first person pronoun in genitive singular

items.question: What prosperity does Aryaman grant to the devotee who bows?
premises: Eternal and greater prosperity are requested.
The speaker is bowed in devotion.
items.inference: Aryaman is invoked to grant lasting and increased prosperity to the bowed devotee.
uncertainties: The exact ritual context of the surrounding deity list remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Aryaman, however, [grant] eternal and greater prosperity to me, who am bowed.
